system.name: MAGIC
system.one_liner: A framework where an MLLM scores generated skin-disease images against expert checklists and the scores fine-tune a diffusion model that augments classifier training data.

content.variant_note: three tinted panels (a)-(c) as stages that share the diffusion model and one photo pair, linked by a dashed score arrow and a dotted data arrow
content.argues: Expert criteria turned into checklist scores by an MLLM can fine-tune a diffusion model so its synthetic skin-disease images are medically accurate enough to improve a classifier.
content.subject: Three stages shown on one lupus-from-sarcoidosis example: generate and score an image pair, fine-tune the diffusion model, train a classifier.

layout.arrangement_note: Three full-bleed tinted panels: (a) blue across the top, (b) green bottom-left and (c) pink bottom-right, each titled on a speckled grey strip. Each panel is a left-to-right chain of icons with captions beneath and photos at the ends. A long dashed arrow runs from the score cards at the top right of (a) down to the fine-tuning icon in (b), and a green dotted arrow runs from the Enhanced DM in (b) to the generated photo in (c).

lessons.what_to_learn: Follow one photo pair through every stage: the same two images reappear in each tinted panel, first with scores, then with thumbs, then as training data, so each stage's input and output are seen on one example. Mark the improved model with the same icon plus a small badge.
lessons.suits: Pipelines with several training or data stages where one concrete sample can be carried through each stage, such as image generation and medical data augmentation.

evidence: A preliminary fine-tuned diffusion model (DM) transforms a source image (e.g., sarcoidosis) to a target condition (e.g., lupus erythematosus)
an MLLM then provides expert checklist-based feedback scores on the generated image pair
This feedback guides the subsequent fine-tuning (e.g., RFT or DPO) of the DM.

summary: MAGIC synthesises medically accurate skin disease images: a multimodal LLM scores generated images against expert checklists, and the scores fine-tune a diffusion model whose images then augment classifier training. Figure 1 draws the method as three tinted panels. In (a), a text prompt and a sarcoidosis source photo go into a diffusion-model icon, which returns a pair of lupus-like images; an AI-expert cycle (OpenAI logo, doctors, clipboard) scores them 5/5 and 2/5 against a lupus checklist. In (b) the same pair, marked with a thumbs-up and a thumbs-down, drives feedback-guided fine-tuning into an Enhanced DM. In (c) that model generates data that, with the source photo, trains a medical classifier. A dashed arrow carries the scores between panels.
summary_zh: MAGIC 用专家清单让多模态大模型给生成的皮肤病图像打分，再用分数微调扩散模型并扩充分类器训练数据。图分 (a)(b)(c) 三个彩色面板，用同一对狼疮图像走完打分、微调和训练分类器三步。
notes: Prior kinds kept. Which generated image carries 5/5 and which 2/5 is inferred from order in (a) and from the thumbs in (b). RFT and DPO are named in the caption but not drawn. The medium of the OpenAI logo and the thumbs is a guess from the digest (7 bitmap icons plus 3 photo bitmaps).
